data.description: Third first-fire attempt (tick log apps/chat/data/logs/tick-2026-08-30T18-20-03.664Z.log): the tick AUTHENTICATED (AS-14 keychain fix works) but ended as a no-op. Root cause: the headless permission layer (claude -p, permission-mode acceptEdits) DENIES environment-variable reads — the tick log states verbatim "the env read was declined by the permission layer" — so the tick could not read ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT and, per the AS-15 rule in advance.md step 0 (a lock it cannot positively claim as its parent is foreign), correctly self-cancelled on its own parent watcher lock. AS-15 chose the right marker but the wrong transport: env vars are not readable inside a headless tick. FIX (transport change, design decided at triage): carry the marker in the PROMPT. The watcher fires claude -p "/advance watcher:<pid>" — the marker rides as the /advance slash-command argument; advance.md declares the argument and step 0 matches the advance.lock pid against the ARGUMENT marker, no env read needed. Keep setting ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT in tickChildEnv as belt-and-suspenders (harmless, and useful in any context where env IS readable), but the prompt argument becomes the contract. Files: apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs fire() argv; .claude/commands/advance.md (argument declaration + step 0 wording — NOTE advance.md is a .claude command file, not a top-level markdown, so employees may edit it); apps/chat/test/watcher.test.js (pin the spawn argv the way tickChildEnv is pinned). Related: AS-16 (pid-reuse nonce) should ride this same prompt-arg transport when built — its design depends on this contract. NOT in scope / NOT a bug: the "watcher re-fired message 120 three times" observation in that tick log is a misdiagnosis from missing context — those were deliberate board-side highwater resets during debugging; the highwater logic is correct. Do not file or fix anything for it.
data.title: advance-watcher: pass the parent-lock marker in the /advance prompt argument — headless permission layer denies env reads

data.body: Planning done (cto-owen). Plan at .lattice/plans/task_01M19YPNDZMS9GDJMFWCEJP48E.md, branch feat/AS-20-prompt-arg-marker. Shape: exported pure tickArgv() helper pinned by test (mirrors the tickChildEnv pin), fire() spawns claude -p '/advance watcher:<pid>', advance.md step 0 claims the parent lock via the ARGUMENT marker (no env read on the happy path), ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT env stays as belt. Out of scope: AS-16 nonce (rides this transport later, linked), and the tick log's re-fire misdiagnosis (deliberate board-side highwater resets). Ready for developer-marcus.

Implementation done (developer-marcus), commit 903b667 on feat/AS-20-prompt-arg-marker. tickArgv(watcherPid, permissionMode) exported pure helper builds ['-p','/advance watcher:<pid>','--permission-mode',<mode>,'--output-format','text']; fire() spawns with tickArgv(process.pid, config.permissionMode); tickChildEnv untouched (ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT stays as belt, spawn-site comment updated to say argument is the contract). advance.md: argument-hint frontmatter + step 0 rewritten to match the lock pid against the ARGUMENT marker, no env read on happy path, watcher-releases-in-settle rule kept, no-argument => foreign lock unchanged for loop/manual ticks. Test: tickArgv pin mirrors the tickChildEnv pin (exact deepEqual array, marker regex, mode passthrough, defaults). Suite in-container: 93 pass, 0 fail (was 92). Not touched: advance.lock, highwater/debounce logic, AS-16 nonce (rides this transport later).

QA review (qa-priya, cold: plan + diff master...feat/AS-20-prompt-arg-marker + in-container suite). VERDICT: PASS — recommend done. Criteria 5/5: (1) tickArgv exported pure helper (advance-watcher.mjs:167), fire() spawns with it (line 418), pinned by deepEqual test — PASS. (2) Prompt element exactly '/advance watcher:<pid>' with process.pid, the same pid main() hands makeLockOps (line 359) and acquireLock writes into advance.lock — provenance verified, PASS. (3) advance.md step 0 claims via the ARGUMENT, no env read on happy path, 'watcher releases its own lock in settle()' rule kept verbatim, argument-hint frontmatter added — PASS. (4) Suite in-container run by me: 93 pass / 0 fail (was 92; +1 tickArgv pin) — PASS. (5) Loop/manual ticks untouched: no code-path change; step 0 explicitly no-ops a watcher lock when no argument marker was given — PASS. Attack results: argv injection — only production caller passes process.pid; permissionMode is watcher-operator env passed as a discrete argv element, spawn() without shell, no injection surface. Marker spoofing — a manual 'claude -p /advance watcher:<pid>' with a read/guessed pid while a watcher lock is fresh WOULD adopt the lock and run a duplicate tick; residual requires local repo access, which already suffices to delete the lock outright — same class as the sanctioned etiquette-not-correctness residual, not worse than AS-16's, and the AS-16 nonce (blocked on this task) closes it properly. Pin falsifiability — full-array literal deepEqual plus default-args case; any argv change fails the test. Non-blocking observations: advance.md carries no $ARGUMENTS placeholder (args reach the tick via the command-args block — works, noted for the record); the regex assert beside the exact-equality assert in the pin test is redundant but documents format intent, left as-is. Extra .lattice files on the branch attributed to cto-owen's triage (3 backlog chat tasks + 1 event append) — legitimate sibling board state, not creep. No inline fixes made. No status change by me per review scope.
